name: lean-bundle-diffs
title: Stop committing per-PR diff dumps into the bundle
outcome: A fresh clone of this repo is not weighed down by every merged PR's full diff text, and the viewer still shows a diff for any PR a reader opens.

min_work.derived_from: data/diffs-pr{N}.js under .cobuilder-architect/ is a per-PR export of extract_diffs.py's output, committed today the same way story.js and adrs.js are. Measured on 2026-08-26: the repo's clone size is ~40 MB, and the largest single files are diffs-pr11.js (6.4 MB) and several more in the hundreds of KB to low MB range, per-PR and permanent. Unlike the narrative and ADRs, a diff is fully reproducible at any time from git diff <merge-base>..<head> as long as history is not rewritten, so committing it buys nothing a live git command could not supply on demand.
min_work.note: Stage 0 and stage 1 grounding did not run. Stages 2 through 7 are deliberately deferred. This design is a backlog entry, not an approved design. It carries no intent.json, narrative.json, assessment.json, or diagrams, and it must not be implemented until design mode runs to completion.

epics.note: Decide the replacement shape: the viewer reads a diff by running git diff against the PR's recorded commit SHAs at serve time (view mode already runs from inside the repo), versus keeping diffs-pr{N}.js exactly as it is today but gitignoring it, regenerating it from git on demand the way exports/branch-*/diff.json already works for generate mode. Either removes the committed weight; they differ in whether a served bundle still needs a live git checkout next to it.

Whichever shape E1 picks, implement it in extract_diffs.py and, if the viewer starts requesting diffs at view time instead of reading a static file, in artifact's serve_bundle.py. Update verify_bundle.py's expectations accordingly.

Migrate the existing committed bundles (self, and the two fixture bundles) so history stops growing: remove the checked-in diffs-pr{N}.js files, or move them under .gitignore, per E1's decision. This does not touch story.json's authored fields, so it is a bundle-file change, not a schema migration.
